title: Understanding Matrix Invertibility
text: To determine if a matrix is invertible, consider its determinant. If the determinant is zero, the matrix is not invertible. Think about how this applies to the matrix $$X^T$$ X.

title: Full Column Rank
text: A matrix has full column rank if all its columns are linearly independent. How does this relate to the invertibility of $$X^T$$ X?

title: Matrix Properties
text: Which property of X ensures that $$X^T$$ X is invertible?
choices: X must not be full column rank.
X must be a square matrix.
X must have fewer rows than columns.
